THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT ANDEASEMENT AGREEMENT(this "Agreement"), made this 18* day of November 2019, by and between UNIVERSITY STONE LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, having an office c/o King Rook Capital LLC, 111 Broadway, Suite 1703, New York, New York 10006, Attention: David Issroff ("Owner"), and 64 UNIVERSITY PLACE LLC, a New York limited liability company, c/o Argo Real Estate LLC and Bsafal Inc, 50 W 17th Street, 6th floor, New York, New York 10010, Attention: Mark Moskowitz and Ameesh Agarwal ("Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner of certain land, with the building(s) and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as 70 University Place and designated as Block 568, Lot 20, on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York (the “Tax Map"), and more particularly described on Exhibit "A" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Owner Land"; the building(s) located thereon is herein referred to as the“Owner Building"; and the Owner Land and the Owner Building are herein WHEREAS, Developer is the owner of certain land, with the building and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as 64 University Place and designated as Block 568, Lot 21 on the Tax Map, and more Land";thebuilding and improvements thereon are herein collectively referred to as the"Existing DeveloperBuilding"); WHEREAS, Developer may enlarge and/or demolish the Existing Developer Building and construct an enlargement and/or new building, all of which will be on the Developer Land and construct other improvements associated with such enlarged and/or new building (the enlarged and/or new building and improvements, together with any additions thereto or future alterations thereto or replacements, repairs or rebuilding thereof not prohibited by the provisions of this Agreement, are herein collectively referred to as the “New Developer Building"; and the Developer Land and the Existing Developer Building or the New Developer Building, as the case may be, are herein collectively referred to as the “Developer Parcel"); WHEREAS, the Owner Building contains less floor area, as defined in the Zoning Resolution (as defined herein), than is now available for use on the Owner Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, so that the Subject Development Rights (as defined herein) are available for transfer to and utilization on the Developer Parcel; WHEREAS, it is contemplated that the New Developer Building will contain more floor area than is now available for use on the Developer Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, and the parties hereto therefore desire to utilize the procedure available pursuant to the Zoning Resolution for the Combined Zoning Lot (as defined herein) so as to make available the Subject Development Rights for utilization in connection with the construction and maintenance of the New Developer Building, and Owner is willing to make such Subject Development Rights available to Developer in perpetuity, subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement;
